stories.title: Estimated
stories.empty: Nothing here yet. Each time you reveal the cards, the estimate is added to this list.
stories.clearConfirm: Remove every story of the backlog? The estimated stories are kept.
stories.backlogNameLabel: Name of story {{number}} of the backlog
stories.moveUp: Move story {{number}} of the backlog up
stories.moveDown: Move story {{number}} of the backlog down
stories.addLabel: Stories to add to the backlog, one per line, such as "ABC-123 Login timeout"

connection.failed: Could not reconnect. Click to reload the page.

currentStory.skipHint: Estimate it later: move it to the end of the backlog

agentAccess.title: AI agents
agentAccess.description: Let an AI agent (Claude, Cursor, Copilot…) read the estimates of this room and fill its backlog, for instance from your issue tracker.
agentAccess.linkHelp: Give this link to your agent, in its chat. Anyone with it can read and change the stories of this room: every player sees that it is on.
agentAccess.setupTitle: First time? Connect your agent to this server
agentAccess.setupHelp: Add this MCP server to your agent once (for instance: claude mcp add --transport http planning-poker <address>). The README explains it for other agents.
agentAccess.renewConfirm: Replace the agent link? Agents that have the current one will not be able to use it anymore.
agentAccess.disableConfirm: Turn off the access of AI agents? Their link stops working.

agentActivity.added: An AI agent added {{count}} stories to the backlog
agentActivity.addedOne: An AI agent added a story to the backlog
agentActivity.moved: An AI agent reordered the backlog
agentActivity.requeued: An AI agent put {{story}} back in the backlog
agentActivity.cleared: An AI agent cleared the backlog
